text:
Alex: Heads-up — we need a serial terraform apply for release/infra-3.2 in the quiet change window tonight 22:00 UTC. Touches IAM role updates + a small Route53 record change. Requesting a single-canary in us-east-1, then stagger across AZs. Link to plan: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-artifacts/tfplans/infra-3.2.plan

DeployBot: Preflight results: PLAN_OK except for drift detected on module.networking.vpc_peering (drift requires manual verification). State snapshot created at s3://redwood-tfstate/backups/2475301234.tfstate.snap. To approve run: `/deploy approve 2475301234`. Auto-abort if plan changes after approval.

Maria: +1, but please pin provider versions in the root module before apply. Also add an IAM gating rule: any IAM policy changes that add >1 privilege must be manually reviewed by Security.

Sahil: FYI — Route53 change will be a TTL reduce and then replace. Keep TTL low (60s) for 10m after cut to minimize cache effects. Rollback plan: if DNS propagation causes failures, revert the record and restore previous healthcheck config.

Jen: Adding rollback playbook here so it's explicit:

```
# Emergency rollback steps (if canary fails)
1) `terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.route53` with previous record values
2) restore tfstate from snapshot:
   aws s3 cp s3://redwood-tfstate/backups/2475301234.tfstate.snap ./restore.tfstate
   terraform state replace-provider -auto-approve # only if provider mismatch
   terraform init -reconfigure
   terraform apply -auto-approve -state=./restore.tfstate
3) notify #incidents and escalate to oncall
```

Jen: Also: if IAM errors occur during canary, do NOT proceed to other AZs. Fail open: abort and revive previous state snapshot.

Alex: Scheduling: canary apply at 22:00 UTC in us-east-1a. If canary stable for 15m (no elevated error rate, no deploybot alerts) then proceed 22:20 -> us-east-1b, 22:35 -> us-east-1c. Canary success criteria: no >2x 5m error rate, no failed auth spikes, plan applies cleanly. Tag release: `release:infra-3.2`

DeployBot: Apply scheduled (job id: apply-20260320-2475301234). Logs will stream here. Auto-abort threshold set: 5 failing steps or explicit abort command. Will post `apply.log` + exit code.

Oncall Bot: Pager settings for tonight: raise error-rate alert threshold x2 for 30m during the canary window. SRE notified: @SRE-rotation.

Maria: Added provider lock snippet to the root module — please confirm before approve:

```
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = { source = "hashicorp/aws", version = "= 4.71.0" }
  }
}
```

Maria: Release notes: https://docs.internal.redwood/release-notes/infra-3.2 — includes IAM changes and the Route53 migration steps.

Alex: LGTM :thumbsup:

Sahil: I'll monitor the canary and keep pager on me. If I see auth failures I'll trigger the rollback playbook and ping @Maria + @Jen.

DeployBot: apply-20260320-2475301234 started streaming logs at 22:00:12 UTC. Plan matched approved version.

Jen: Leaving checklist here: 1) provider lock confirmed, 2) state snapshot present, 3) IAM gating enabled, 4) rollback commands posted. All good from my side.

Alex: Thanks all — will post postmortem if anything odd.

Sahil: :eyes:
